grammar.pattern: 比较 / 更加 / 还 / 相当：程度
grammar.purpose: Distinguish an explicit comparison from a degree modifier
grammar.explanation: 比较清楚 may mean relatively clear without naming a comparator; 比昨天清楚 is explicit. 更加清楚 builds on a prior degree. 还 can mean even more in 他比我还快, distinct from continuing 还在练. 相当难 means quite difficult here, not a claim two objects are equivalent. Use context, and do not infer a numeric gain.

examples.py: zhè yī duàn bǐ jiào róng yì .
zhè cì gèng jiā qīng chǔ .
examples.en: This time it is even clearer.

examples.zh: 他比我还快，但我还在练。
examples.py: tā bǐ wǒ hái kuài , dàn wǒ hái zài liàn .
examples.en: He is even faster than me, but I am still practising.

commonMistakes.wrong: 比较清楚就是一定比所有人清楚。
commonMistakes.right: 比较清楚不一定说了比较对象。
commonMistakes.why: A relative degree word does not identify every comparator.

grammar.pattern: A比B说得清楚 / A不比B快 / 比B多读一遍
grammar.explanation: 她比我说得清楚 and 她说得比我清楚 compare manner. A不比B快 denies A being faster, allowing equality or slower, rather than proving B is strictly faster. 我比她多读一遍 states one extra repetition; 我比她早到十分钟 states a time difference. 不如 often implies inferiority and differs from 不比. Preserve the dimension and stated amount.

examples.py: tā shuō de bǐ wǒ qīng chǔ .
examples.en: She speaks more clearly than I do.

examples.zh: 我不比她快，可能一样快。
examples.py: wǒ bù bǐ tā kuài , kě néng yī yàng kuài .
examples.en: I am not faster than her; we may be equally fast.

examples.py: wǒ bǐ tā duō dú yī biàn .
examples.en: I read it one more time than she did.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不比她快，所以她一定更快。
commonMistakes.right: 我不比她快，可能一样快，也可能更慢。
commonMistakes.why: Negating faster allows equality; it does not force strict reversal.

lines.zh: 昨天那首歌，你今天还想练吗？
lines.py: zuó tiān nà shǒu gē , nǐ jīn tiān hái xiǎng liàn ma ?
lines.en: Do you want to practise yesterday's song again today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 想。今天比昨天清楚多了，不过最后一句还没唱好。
lines.py: xiǎng . jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān qīng chǔ duō le , bù guò zuì hòu yī jù hái méi chàng hǎo .
lines.en: Yes. It's much clearer today, but I still can't get the last line right.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我唱一遍，你听听？
lines.py: wǒ chàng yī biàn , nǐ tīng tīng ?
lines.en: Shall I sing it once for you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。别太快，我想听清每个字。
lines.py: hǎo . bié tài kuài , wǒ xiǎng tīng qīng měi gè zì .
lines.en: Yes. Not too fast; I want to hear every word.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这样行吗？
lines.py: zhè yàng xíng ma ?
lines.en: Is this okay?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，这次比较容易跟。再来一遍吧。
lines.py: xíng , zhè cì bǐ jiào róng yì gēn . zài lái yī biàn ba .
lines.en: Yes. This time it's fairly easy to follow. Once more, please.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你已经唱了三遍，我只唱了两遍。
lines.py: nǐ yǐ jīng chàng le sān biàn , wǒ zhǐ chàng le liǎng biàn .
lines.en: You've sung it three times; I've sung it only twice.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那你再唱一次，正好。
lines.py: nà nǐ zài chàng yī cì , zhèng hǎo .
lines.en: One more from you will make it even.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 下周五的演唱会，你买票了吗？
lines.py: xià zhōu wǔ de yǎn chàng huì , nǐ mǎi piào le ma ?
lines.en: Have you got a ticket for next Friday's concert?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 买了，七点开门，八点开始。
lines.py: mǎi le , qī diǎn kāi mén , bā diǎn kāi shǐ .
lines.en: Yes. Doors open at seven; it starts at eight.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们六点半在车站见？
lines.py: wǒ men liù diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn ?
lines.en: Meet at the station at six thirty?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，在路上还可以唱，不过小声一点。
lines.py: hǎo , zài lù shàng hái kě yǐ chàng , bù guò xiǎo shēng yī diǎn .
lines.en: Okay. We can sing on the way, but quietly.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A karaoke practice note
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 陈宇昨天和我练一首歌，最后一句我总是唱不清。他今天又来，我们先把这句读慢一点，再一起唱。
lines.py: chén yǔ zuó tiān hé wǒ liàn yī shǒu gē , zuì hòu yī jù wǒ zǒng shì chàng bù qīng . tā jīn tiān yòu lái , wǒ men xiān bǎ zhè jù dú màn yī diǎn , zài yì qǐ chàng .
lines.en: Chen Yu and I practised a song yesterday, but I couldn't sing the last line clearly. When he came today we read it slowly first, then sang it together.

lines.zh: 我唱了三遍，他唱了两遍。我让他再唱一次，他故意拿着笔当话筒，站得像已经上了舞台。
lines.py: wǒ chàng le sān biàn , tā chàng le liǎng biàn . wǒ ràng tā zài chàng yī cì , tā gù yì ná zhe bǐ dāng huà tǒng , zhàn de xiàng yǐ jīng shàng le wǔ tái .
lines.en: I sang it three times and he sang it twice. I asked for one more; he used his pen as a microphone and stood as though already onstage.

lines.zh: 这一遍我听清了最后两个字，就跟着唱。他说比昨天好听，我也觉得今天更加轻松，不再只顾着赶上音乐。
lines.py: zhè yī biàn wǒ tīng qīng le zuì hòu liǎng gè zì , jiù gēn zhe chàng . tā shuō bǐ zuó tiān hǎo tīng , wǒ yě jué de jīn tiān gèng jiā qīng sōng , bù zài zhǐ gù zhe gǎn shàng yīn yuè .
lines.en: I heard the last two words this time and sang along. He thought it sounded better than yesterday. I felt more relaxed too, rather than just trying to keep up with the music.

lines.zh: 下周五我们要去看演唱会。七点开门，八点开始，所以约好六点半在车站见，先一起吃点东西。
lines.py: xià zhōu wǔ wǒ men yào qù kàn yǎn chàng huì . qī diǎn kāi mén , bā diǎn kāi shǐ , suǒ yǐ yuē hǎo liù diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn , xiān yì qǐ chī diǎn dōng xi .
lines.en: We're going to a concert next Friday. Doors open at seven and it starts at eight. We'll meet at the station at six thirty and get something to eat first.

lines.zh: 我最喜欢的歌手这次和乐队一起演出。以前我只听过歌声，这次还想看看他们在舞台上怎么互相配合。
lines.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de gē shǒu zhè cì hé yuè duì yì qǐ yǎn chū . yǐ qián wǒ zhǐ tīng guò gē shēng , zhè cì hái xiǎng kàn kàn tā men zài wǔ tái shàng zěn me hù xiāng pèi hé .
lines.en: My favourite singer is performing with a band. Before I'd only heard the singing; now I wanted to see how they worked together onstage.

lines.zh: 晚上我把笔收好，陈宇还问下次有没有话筒。我说话筒没有，两支笔倒是有，让他选一个颜色就行。
lines.py: wǎn shang wǒ bǎ bǐ shōu hǎo , chén yǔ hái wèn xià cì yǒu méi yǒu huà tǒng . wǒ shuō huà tǒng méi yǒu , liǎng zhī bǐ dǎo shì yǒu , ràng tā xuǎn yī gè yán sè jiù xíng .
lines.en: That evening I put away the pen. Chen Yu asked whether we'd have a microphone next time. We wouldn't, I said, but I had two pens; he could choose a colour.

choices: The difficult line becomes clearer and a pen becomes a pretend microphone
questions.answer: The difficult line becomes clearer and a pen becomes a pretend microphone

questions.q: What time does the concert start?
Why offer two pens at the end?

lines.zh: 蓝色的笔还是黑色的笔？
lines.py: lán sè de bǐ hái shi hēi sè de bǐ ?
lines.en: The blue pen or the black pen?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 哪个唱得好听？
lines.py: nǎ gè chàng de hǎo tīng ?
lines.en: Which one sounds better when singing?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 笔都一样，是你唱。
lines.py: bǐ dōu yī yàng , shì nǐ chàng .
lines.en: They're just pens. You're the one singing.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我选蓝色，看起来像上台了。
lines.py: nà wǒ xuǎn lán sè , kàn qǐ lái xiàng shàng tái le .
lines.en: I'll take the blue one. It makes me look ready for the stage.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先把盖子盖好，别把嘴涂蓝了。
lines.py: xiān bǎ gài zi gài hǎo , bié bǎ zuǐ tú lán le .
lines.en: Put the cap on first. Don't colour your mouth blue.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，今天只唱歌，不画画。
lines.py: hǎo , jīn tiān zhǐ chàng gē , bù huà huà .

lines.py: tā yǒu qiáng liè de yuàn wàng , xiǎng huí jiā kàn kàn .
lines.en: She has a strong desire to go home for a visit.

lines.zh: 阳光很强烈，我们坐到树下吧。
lines.py: yáng guāng hěn qiáng liè , wǒ men zuò dào shù xià ba .
lines.en: The sunlight is intense. Let's sit under the tree.

lines.zh: 我们还想进一步了解这个地方。
lines.py: wǒ men hái xiǎng jìn yí bù liǎo jiě zhè gè dì fāng .
lines.en: We'd like to learn more about this place.

lines.zh: 他把计划进一步说清楚了。
lines.py: tā bǎ jì huà jìn yí bù shuō qīng chǔ le .
lines.en: He explained the plan more clearly.

lines.zh: 你的中文进步很大。
lines.py: nǐ de zhōng wén jìn bù hěn dà .
lines.en: Your Chinese has improved a lot.

lines.zh: 她每天练习，一点一点进步。
lines.py: tā měi tiān liàn xí , yī diǎn yī diǎn jìn bù .
lines.en: She practises daily and improves bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我们改进了做法。
lines.py: wǒ men gǎi jìn le zuò fǎ .
lines.en: We improved our approach.

lines.zh: 这个安排还有改进的地方。
lines.py: zhè gè ān pái hái yǒu gǎi jìn de dì fāng .
lines.en: This arrangement still has room for improvement.

lines.zh: 她的画画技术很好。
lines.py: tā de huà huà jì shù hěn hǎo .
lines.en: Her drawing technique is good.

lines.zh: 他想学习新的技术。
lines.py: tā xiǎng xué xí xīn de jì shù .
lines.en: He wants to learn new techniques.

lines.zh: 我对艺术很有兴趣。
lines.py: wǒ duì yì shù hěn yǒu xìng qù .
lines.en: I'm interested in art.

lines.zh: 这座城市有一所艺术学校。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì yǒu yī suǒ yì shù xué xiào .
lines.en: This city has an art school.

lines.zh: 演员已经站在舞台上了。
lines.py: yǎn yuán yǐ jīng zhàn zài wǔ tái shàng le .
lines.en: The performer is already onstage.

lines.zh: 舞台前面有一排椅子。
lines.py: wǔ tái qián miàn yǒu yī pái yǐ zi .
lines.en: There's a row of chairs in front of the stage.

lines.zh: 她演唱了一首新歌。
lines.py: tā yǎn chàng le yī shǒu xīn gē .
lines.en: She sang a new song.

lines.zh: 今晚谁来演唱？
lines.py: jīn wǎn shéi lái yǎn chàng ?
lines.en: Who's singing tonight?

lines.zh: 演唱会八点开始。
lines.py: yǎn chàng huì bā diǎn kāi shǐ .
lines.en: The concert starts at eight.

lines.zh: 我和朋友一起去看演唱会。
lines.py: wǒ hé péng you yì qǐ qù kàn yǎn chàng huì .
lines.en: I went to a concert with a friend.

lines.zh: 演出结束以后，我们才吃饭。
lines.py: yǎn chū jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ men cái chī fàn .
lines.en: We ate only after the performance ended.

lines.zh: 这次演出很成功。
lines.py: zhè cì yǎn chū hěn chéng gōng .
lines.en: This performance went well.

lines.zh: 这个演员我以前见过。
lines.py: zhè gè yǎn yuán wǒ yǐ qián jiàn guò .
lines.en: I've seen this actor before.

lines.zh: 她从小就想当演员。
lines.py: tā cóng xiǎo jiù xiǎng dāng yǎn yuán .
lines.en: She's wanted to be a performer since childhood.

lines.zh: 这位歌手的声音很好听。
lines.py: zhè wèi gē shǒu de shēng yīn hěn hǎo tīng .
lines.en: This singer has a lovely voice.

lines.zh: 我最喜欢的歌手出新歌了。
lines.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de gē shǒu chū xīn gē le .
lines.en: My favourite singer released a new song.

lines.zh: 我在门外听见了歌声。
lines.py: wǒ zài mén wài tīng jiàn le gē shēng .
lines.en: I heard singing outside the door.

lines.zh: 歌声停了，大家拍手。
lines.py: gē shēng tíng le , dà jiā pāi shǒu .
lines.en: The singing stopped and everyone applauded.

lines.zh: 很多歌迷在门口等。
lines.py: hěn duō gē mí zài mén kǒu děng .
lines.en: Lots of fans are waiting at the entrance.

lines.zh: 她是这位歌手的歌迷。
lines.py: tā shì zhè wèi gē shǒu de gē mí .
lines.en: She's a fan of this singer.

lines.zh: 这支乐队有四个人。
lines.py: zhè zhī yuè duì yǒu sì gè rén .
lines.en: There are four people in this band.

lines.zh: 乐队正在练习。
lines.py: yuè duì zhèng zài liàn xí .
lines.en: The band is rehearsing.

lines.zh: 今天的演出很精彩。
lines.py: jīn tiān de yǎn chū hěn jīng cǎi .
lines.en: Today's performance was wonderful.

lines.zh: 故事最精彩的地方还没到。
lines.py: gù shì zuì jīng cǎi de dì fāng hái méi dào .
lines.en: We haven't reached the most exciting part of the story yet.

audio.zh: 买了，七点开门，八点开始。
audio.py: mǎi le , qī diǎn kāi mén , bā diǎn kāi shǐ .
audio.en: Yes. Doors open at seven; it starts at eight.

tasks.why: The heard line states this fact.

audio.zh: 晚上我把笔收好，陈宇还问下次有没有话筒。我说话筒没有，两支笔倒是有，让他选一个颜色就行。
audio.py: wǎn shang wǒ bǎ bǐ shōu hǎo , chén yǔ hái wèn xià cì yǒu méi yǒu huà tǒng . wǒ shuō huà tǒng méi yǒu , liǎng zhī bǐ dǎo shì yǒu , ràng tā xuǎn yī gè yán sè jiù xíng .
audio.en: That evening I put away the pen. Chen Yu asked whether we'd have a microphone next time. We wouldn't, I said, but I had two pens; he could choose a colour.

tasks.statement: The narrator offers a real microphone for next time.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly describes a different result.
